answer: Under Section 4 of the agreement, if a Change of Control results in the Party being controlled by a Third Party that markets or sells a Competing Product, the rights under the Agreement may not be assigned without the express consent of the other Party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld. The definition of 'Change of Control' includes the sale, lease, exchange, license, or disposition of all or substantially all assets, or a merger/consolidation where the original shareholders own less than a majority of the surviving entity. Additionally, for the purposes of Section 6.3(b)(iii), a Change of Control includes any sale of securities resulting in a transfer of more than 50% of the outstanding voting stock. The sources do not explicitly state a right to terminate, but rather restrict assignment without consent in specific competitive scenarios.

query_id: PACIRA PHARMACEUTICALS, INC. - A_R STRATEGIC LICENSING, DISTRIBUTION AND MARKETING AGREEMENT __Audit Rights
doc_id: PACIRA PHARMACEUTICALS, INC. - A_R STRATEGIC LICENSING, DISTRIBUTION AND MARKETING AGREEMENT
answer: Yes, the contract grants PPI the right to audit EKR's records. Specifically, Section 7.3 allows PPI to appoint an independent auditor to inspect EKR's records and books of account during business hours, provided PPI gives at least 14 days' notice and conducts the inspection no more than once per calendar year. The purpose of this audit is to verify the accuracy of statements or reports given by EKR and the amount of royalties due (Section 7.3, Source [3]). The auditor must maintain strict confidentiality (Section 7.4, Source [3]). If the audit reveals an underpayment, EKR must pay the deficit within 30 days; if it reveals an overpayment, PPI must refund the excess. PPI pays the auditor's fees unless the audit reveals that payments due to PPI were understated, in which case EKR may be responsible for the fees (Section 7.5, Source [3]). The contract does not explicitly mention the right to audit physical locations, only records and books.
